unit: one K-block iteration producing two output rows by five columns unless stated

designs.tail: Eligible only when M is even; odd M and every unmarked batch use the registered fallback.
designs.evidence: The registered Q6_K rows=2 MoE symbol emits 14 relevant loads instead of 18, proving the compiler can retain one Q8_1 packet across two row dots without LDS.

designs.reason: It repeats the shared Q6 fields fivefold and adds no useful work reduction. Large M already supplies independent row-level wave parallelism.
It preserves the memory and dot work while adding partial-result reduction and synchronization.
The larger 20-accumulator live set and possible LDS/barrier requirement are not bounded by a registered code-object precedent. R4 must not be hidden in the R2 experiment.
